scripts.build: if [ -d "client" ]; then cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r client/dist dist; else npm run build; fi
scripts.vercel-build: if [ -d "client" ]; then cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r client/dist dist; else npm run build; fi
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
